metadata.name: schedina
metadata.description: Schedina: parlay tickets over Pascal markets, backed by a house vault

instructions.name: cash_out
docs: Pays the desk-signed cash-out value. Needs the `Ed25519Program` verify
instruction immediately before this one, over exactly `quote`'s borsh bytes.
Ticket user signs. `remaining_accounts`: own tip `[tipster_profile (w)]`
(required), otherwise none.

instructions.name: faucet_usdc
docs: Mints mock USDC to `recipient`, as often as asked (D-661). `devnet` feature only.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Mints the ticket at fill prices `fills` (0 = unhedged leg) and fill ratio
`r_ppm`, refunding `S - rS` (plus the unspent copy fee). Crank only.
`remaining_accounts`: own tip `[tipster_profile (w)]` (created if absent, crank
pays); copy `[orig_ticket, tipster_usdc (w)]`; otherwise none.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: `pending.rent_receiver()`; any owner (a smart-wallet user must still get the refund).

accounts.name: user_usdc
docs: Receives the refund `S - rS`; any USDC account owned by the pending's user.

instructions.name: fund_vault
docs: Deposits `amount` micro-USDC into the house vault. Anyone.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Creates `Config`, `Vault`, the mock USDC mint and the vault and escrow token
accounts. Upgrade authority only.

accounts.name: deployer
docs: Upgrade authority of this program; pays rent.

instructions.name: init_tipster_profile
docs: Creates the `TipsterProfile` of `wallet` if absent (2.F; `finalize` also creates
it for an own tip). Anyone; the payer pays the rent.

instructions.name: open_pending
docs: Escrows the stake of a desk-signed quote with the user's floor. The quote is the
message of the `Ed25519Program` verify instruction immediately before this one
(borsh `QuoteMsg`, signed by `Config.quote_signer`). User signs.

accounts.name: user
docs: Authority of `user_usdc`; pays nothing (L8: `payer` pays the rent).

accounts.name: user_usdc
docs: The user's USDC. No mint account in this instruction (it saves 33 bytes of a
tight transaction): SPL Token's `transfer` into the escrow, a mock-USDC account,
fails for any other mint.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the Pending's rent, recorded as `Pending.rent_payer` (L8). Last before the
event-CPI accounts, so the earlier account indices are unchanged.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pauses (or resumes) `open_pending` and `finalize`. Authority only.

instructions.name: refund_pending
docs: Returns an unfinalized pending's escrow from `expires_at + 15 s`. Anyone.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; pays the transaction fee only.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: `pending.rent_receiver()`; any owner (a smart-wallet user must still get the refund).

instructions.name: resolve_leg
docs: Records Pascal's resolution `r_ppm` of leg `leg_index`. Crank (or authority).

accounts.name: resolver
docs: `Config.crank` or `Config.authority`.

instructions.name: set_params
docs: Replaces the tunable parameters and backend keys. Authority only.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Pays `P × Π r̃` once every leg is resolved. Anyone. `remaining_accounts`: own
tip `[tipster_profile (w)]` (required), otherwise none.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; pays the transaction fee only.

instructions.name: withdraw_house
docs: Withdraws `amount` from `Vault.free`, never below `Config.reserve`. Authority only.

types.name: CashOutMsg
docs: Desk cash-out quote. Signed bytes = borsh of this struct:
`tag[19] ‖ program_id[32] ‖ ticket[32] ‖ c_u u64 ‖ ts i64` = 99 bytes.

fields.name: tag
docs: `b"schedina/cashout/v1"`.

fields.name: ticket
docs: The `Ticket` PDA.

fields.name: c_u
docs: Amount paid to the user, micro-USDC, `<= Ticket.payout_u`.

fields.name: ts
docs: Desk Unix time of the quote; valid while `|now - ts| <= 30`.

types.name: Config
docs: Global parameters. PDA `["config"]`.

fields.name: authority
docs: Offline key: `set_params`, `pause`, `withdraw_house`, the 0.5 resolution exception.

fields.name: crank
docs: Backend key: `finalize`, `resolve_leg`.

fields.name: quote_signer
docs: Backend key whose ed25519 signature `open_pending` and `cash_out` verify.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Mock USDC, PDA `["mock", "USDC"]`, 6 decimals, mint authority = this `Config`.

fields.name: copy_fee_bps
docs: Copy fee in bps of stake (2.F; 200 = 2%).

fields.name: tipster_share_bps
docs: Tipster share of the copy fee in bps (2.F; 8_000 = 80%).

fields.name: max_legs
docs: Legs per ticket, `1..=MAX_LEGS`.

fields.name: max_payout
docs: Largest ticket payout, micro-USDC.

fields.name: min_stake
docs: Smallest stake, micro-USDC.

fields.name: reserve
docs: `withdraw_house` never takes `Vault.free` below this.

fields.name: paused
docs: Blocks `open_pending` and `finalize` (exits stay open).

types.name: ConfigUpdated
docs: `set_params` and `pause`: the config after the change.

types.name: FaucetClaim
docs: Last faucet claim per recipient owner (devnet builds only; no cooldown since D-661). PDA
`["faucet", owner]`.

fields.name: r_ppm
docs: Pascal's resolution price of the symbol (long side).

fields.name: rtilde_ppm
docs: The ticket's factor for this leg (`r` long, `1e6 - r` short).

types.name: Params
docs: Everything `set_params` can change, plus the authority at init.

types.name: Pending
docs: A user's escrowed request for a ticket, alive 30-60 s. PDA
`["pending", user, nonce u64 LE]`. Closed (rent to [`Pending::rent_receiver`]) by
`finalize` or `refund_pending`.

fields.name: stake_u
docs: Escrowed stake (`quote.stake_u`).

fields.name: copy_fee_u
docs: Escrowed copy fee (2.F; 0 in the MVP).

fields.name: legs
docs: Legs `0..n` as signed by the desk; the rest zeroed.

fields.name: odds_offered_u
docs: `quote.odds_offered_u`.

fields.name: min_payout_per_unit_u
docs: The user's floor: `finalize` needs `payout_u * 1e6 >= min_payout_per_unit_u * rs_u`.

fields.name: quote_hash
docs: sha256 of the signed quote bytes.

fields.name: quote_sig
docs: The desk's ed25519 signature over those bytes.

fields.name: expires_at
docs: `finalize` needs `now < expires_at`; `refund_pending` needs `now >= expires_at + 15`.

fields.name: tipster
docs: `Some(user)` when `is_tip`.

fields.name: copied_from
docs: Original ticket of a copy (2.F; always `None` in the MVP).

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who paid this account's rent (`open_pending`'s `payer`: the user, or the desk's
sponsor key, L8). Takes the 32 bytes that were `reserved`, so the layout is unchanged;
all zeros on a Pending opened before L8.

types.name: PendingOpened
docs: What starts the hedge.

fields.name: amount_u
docs: Stake plus copy fee returned.

types.name: QuoteLeg
docs: One leg as quoted by the desk (85 bytes borsh).

fields.name: symbol_hash
docs: sha256 of the Pascal symbol string, e.g. `NBA_26OCT28_PHIIND_ML.PHI`.

fields.name: game_id_hash
docs: sha256 of `display_attributes.game_page.game_id`, e.g. `nba-phi-ind-2026-10-28`.

fields.name: start_ts
docs: `expected_event_start_time_ms / 1000`.

fields.name: side
docs: 0 long, 1 short.

fields.name: price_u
docs: Ask-side quote price `p_i` for the user's side, micro-units in `(0, 1e6]`.

fields.name: m1_ppm
docs: Per-leg margin, 30_000 (no overlap) or 50_000 (overlap).

types.name: Ticket
docs: A minted parlay. PDA `["ticket", user, nonce u64 LE]`. Immutable except
`legs[].status`, `legs[].resolution_ppm`, `state`, `paid_u`, `resolved_at`. Never closed.

fields.name: stake_u
docs: Stake behind the ticket, `rS` (C2 `rs_u`).

fields.name: refund_u
docs: `S - rS`, returned at `finalize`.

fields.name: payout_u
docs: Locked payout `P` (C2 `payout_u`).

fields.name: odds_u
docs: `floor(P * 1e6 / rS)`.

fields.name: odds_offered_u
docs: The desk's signed offered odds.

fields.name: r_ppm
docs: Fill ratio `r`.

fields.name: fee_u
docs: `rS × m(n)`, for the books (no transfer: the margin is inside `P`).

fields.name: copy_fee_u
docs: Copy fee charged (2.F; 0 in the MVP).

fields.name: resolved_at
docs: When the ticket left `Open` (settle or cash-out); 0 before.

fields.name: paid_u
docs: Amount paid out at settle or cash-out; 0 before.

types.name: TicketLeg
docs: A minted leg.

fields.name: side
docs: 0 long, 1 short.

fields.name: price_u
docs: Signed quote price `p_i`.

fields.name: fill_u
docs: Price used in the payout: the fill for a hedged leg, `price_u` otherwise.

fields.name: hedged
docs: `true` when `finalize` got a non-zero fill for this leg.

fields.name: resolution_ppm
docs: Pascal's resolution `r` (long side), micro-units; 0 while `Open`.

fields.name: fills
docs: The crank's `fills` argument (0 = unhedged leg).

types.name: TipsterPaid
docs: `finalize` of a copy: the tipster's share of the copy fee, paid to their USDC account.

types.name: TipsterProfile
docs: A tipster's own-tip record (2.F). PDA `["tipster", wallet]`. Own tips only
(`ticket.tipster == Some(ticket.user)`, `copied_from == None`): `finalize` adds a
ticket to `open_*`; `settle`/`cash_out` move it to `settled_count`, `won` (returned
more than staked), `settled_staked` and `returned` (paid or `C`). Stakes are the
ticket's `rS`. `fees_earned` stays 0: copies never touch a profile, so copy-fee
income is the sum of `TipsterPaid` events.

types.name: Vault
docs: House accounting. PDA `["vault"]`. Invariants: `locked == Σ payout_u` over `Open`
tickets; `free + locked ==` balance of `usdc_ata`.

fields.name: usdc_ata
docs: House token account, PDA `["vault_usdc"]` (owner `Config`).

fields.name: escrow_ata
docs: Escrow token account for pending stakes, PDA `["escrow_usdc"]` (owner `Config`);
its balance is `Σ (stake_u + copy_fee_u)` over live `Pending` accounts.

fields.name: locked
docs: Full payout of every open ticket.

fields.name: free
docs: Unencumbered house money.

fields.name: lp_shares
docs: v2 (LP vault); always 0.

constants.name: CASHOUT_TAG
docs: First bytes of every signed cash-out message.

constants.name: CASHOUT_TTL
docs: A cash-out quote is valid while `|now - ts| <= CASHOUT_TTL`.

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: `Config` PDA: `["config"]`. Also the token authority of the mock mint and of both
program token accounts.

constants.name: ESCROW_USDC_SEED
docs: Escrow token account holding every open `Pending`'s stake, PDA `["escrow_usdc"]`,
owner `Config`.

constants.name: FAUCET_COOLDOWN
docs: Seconds between two `faucet_usdc` claims by the same recipient owner. Unused since D-661
(no cooldown); kept so the 1.C IDL's constants stay as they were.

constants.name: FAUCET_MAX
docs: Largest `faucet_usdc` mint per claim: 10,000 mock USDC.

constants.name: FAUCET_SEED
docs: `FaucetClaim` PDA: `["faucet", owner]` (`devnet` builds only).

constants.name: MOCK_SEED
docs: Mock mints (`MockMint`): `["mock", symbol]`; mock USDC is `["mock", "USDC"]`.

constants.name: ONE
docs: `1.0` in micro-units (prices, probabilities, odds, `_ppm` ratios).

constants.name: PENDING_SEED
docs: `Pending` PDA: `["pending", user, nonce u64 LE]`.

constants.name: PENDING_TTL_MIN
docs: `Pending.expires_at` must lie in `[now + MIN, now + MAX]` at `open_pending` (C3). MAX was
60 s; 360 s since D-664, so a wallet prompt may take as long as the 5 min quote.

constants.name: QUOTE_TAG
docs: First bytes of every signed quote message (C3 domain separation).

constants.name: REFUND_GRACE
docs: `refund_pending` opens this long after `expires_at`, so a `finalize` sent before
expiry cannot lose the race.

constants.name: TICKET_SEED
docs: `Ticket` PDA: `["ticket", user, nonce u64 LE]` (same nonce as its `Pending`).

constants.name: TIPSTER_SEED
docs: `TipsterProfile` PDA: `["tipster", wallet]` (step 2.F).

constants.name: USDC_DECIMALS
docs: Mock USDC decimals (micro-USDC units).

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: `Vault` PDA: `["vault"]` (accounting of the house token account).

constants.name: VAULT_USDC_SEED
docs: House USDC token account (`Vault.usdc_ata`), PDA `["vault_usdc"]`, owner `Config`.
